_notes: Example args for workflows/design-visuals.js. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the workflow. All values are placeholders.
Slots (start/end) are PROJECT ms on the FINAL timeline (after every cut and chapter card): run a job per stretch between cards,
split at sentence boundaries into 30 to 120 s jobs, one scene per job (job.mjs refuses a range that crosses a scene boundary).
mode behind = talking to camera, the render is the visual; mode front = transparent callouts over the creator's real footage.
Omit `job` and set prepare:true to have the workflow create the jobs (sequentially, ceil-sized, drift phase registered).
frames defaults to ceil((end - start) * 30 / 1000). The REA video used 13 jobs: 10 behind, 3 front.
kit_dir must be $BORUMI_AGENT_HOME/animation-kit (job.mjs only reads BORUMI_AGENT_HOME); style velour = templates/velour-style, installed and checked in SKILL step 0.
title: Tally
creator: Alex
topic: A tutorial about Tally, a fictional open-source CLI that audits a codebase.
direction: "When I'm talking through something, I want a visual aid as proof." "Most of the video needs visualizations."
reference_jobs: anim-xxxxxxxx: real screenshots in browser cards with a URL bar, highlight rings on the spoken number, source pills, calm crossfades
anim-yyyyyyyy: a clean step-by-step board for a concept

broll.desc: 8.6 s real screen recording, original app -> the rebuilt one; light-mode UI, so dim or frame it; 16:9, show at its own aspect
8.9 s handheld device footage; v2 has the on-screen list blurred (never use v1)

honesty_notes: The license covers Tally itself; its disclaimer puts authorization on the user, so never print 'resell'.
The $15 price is a launch price ($39 regular), and there is no free trial (a 14-day refund instead).
privacy_rules: Never show the price or join page of the creator's community; the ending shows a real community post instead.
